core_obligations: Record the functorial properties: a finite morphism is affine, so pushforward is exact; it is proper, so pushforward preserves coherence; and it preserves the bound on the dimension of the support (proof lines 3919-3926).
Establish commutativity on the right square by the statement identifying the cycle class of a pushed forward sheaf (proof lines 3927-3928).
Conclude commutativity on the left, since the horizontal arrows are bijections (proof lines 3929-3930).
proof_roadmap: Left hand square by bijectivity (proof lines 3929-3930).
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that pushforward along a finite morphism is exact, preserves the truncation on dimensions, induces maps on the relevant K-groups, and fits into a commutative diagram with the cycle and K-group identifications (statement lines 3897-3917, tag 02S8-adjacent). The proof assembles exactness and coherence from the standard properties of finite morphisms, obtains commutativity of the right hand square from the cycle class computation for pushed forward sheaves, and deduces the left hand square from bijectivity of the horizontal arrows. The assembly and the deduction are the substance, so the claim is H2.
